subject: Copywriting
title: Simplicity Is Genius
description: A micro-lesson that makes Simplicity Is Genius usable.

hook.text: 'Think small.' 'Got Milk?' 'Just Do It.' The most powerful copy in history fits on a sticky note.

buildup.text: Bernbach cut. Wieden cut. Every legend removed words until only the essential remained. Brevity was the goal.

discovery.text: Hopkins proved simple copy outsells clever copy. Reeves repeated one message endlessly.

twist.text: Simplicity is the hardest thing to write. Blaise Pascal: 'I would have written a shorter letter but I didn't have time.'

climax.text: Every legend agrees: after writing, cut. Then cut again. When you can't remove anything, the copy is done.

punchline.text: Cut until nothing is left to cut. That's great copy.

quiz.question: What did Blaise Pascal say about writing short?
options: He didn't have time to write a shorter letter
